acceptanceCriteria: docs/DOGFOOD.md states whether a linked worktree is a supported checkout for the loop, with the reason.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews and worker reports of the V1 wave-2 pull requests (#82-#85). PR #83 (V1-0010): the coordinator's worker protocol claimed the loop refuses linked worktrees; the worker observed that it does not.
title: worker protocol: linked worktrees are not refused by the dogfood loop
